fusions.name: Dragged Under
fusions.desc: Seizes a target at or below 30% health and deals 20 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Waterhole Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 3 tiles away and bites for 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Mud Wallow
fusions.desc: You regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds, and you take 10% less physical damage.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 35% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
